create.name: Joan Ranquet
create.bio:
Joan Ranquet is an American animal communicator, energy worker and teacher who has worked with animals and their people professionally for around thirty years. She describes animal communication as a learnable skill rather than a rare gift, and her teaching centres on telepathic connection with animals, grounding and sensing the energy of a home, the chakras of dogs, cats and horses, EFT tapping for animals and their guardians, and keeping a connection with animals who have died. She lives on a small ranch in southern California with her horses, dogs and cats, which also serve as teaching partners for her students.

In 2009 she founded Communication With All Life University (CWALU), an online and in-person school offering courses and certification in animal communication, energy work, and nature and wildlife. Her books include Communication With All Life (Hay House), Energy Healing for Animals (Sounds True), Emotional Freedom Technique for Animals and Their Humans, co-written with Ellie Laks, and Animal Chakra Healing (Findhorn Press). She has given a TEDx talk on animals in transition, leads wildlife journeys to places such as Thula Thula in South Africa, and teaches self-paced courses on The Shift Network.

books.title: Communication With All Life: Revelations of An Animal Communicator
books.author: Joan Ranquet
books.description: Her first book, published by Hay House, on telepathic communication with animals. Through stories from her practice it suggests that people already exchange feelings, words and pictures with their animals, and shows how to notice and build on this.

books.title: Animal Chakra Healing: Bringing Balance, Health, and Joy to Our Animal Companions
books.author: Joan Ranquet
books.description: A guide to the chakra system in domestic animals, with chapters on each of the seven main chakras and an eighth linked to an animal's aura and household. It compares cats, dogs and horses using case studies, chakra charts and checklists.

courses.title: Talk to the Animals: Animal Communication for Beginners
courses.description: A six-module self-paced beginners' course in telepathic animal communication from her school, CWALU. Each step includes exercises with her own animals so students can check what they receive.

courses.title: Keep the Memory Alive: Communicating with Animals in the Beyond
courses.description: A self-paced course on connecting with animals who have died. Students practise by communicating with two of her own animals who have crossed over, for themselves or as preparation for professional work.

courses.title: Lost Animals Fundamentals
courses.description: An eight-lesson self-paced course for animal communicators who want to work on lost animal cases using telepathic communication. It can also be followed by guardians whose own animal is missing.

courses.title: Energy Sensing & Grounding for You and Your Animals
courses.description: A short digital masterclass teaching a combined grounding technique and meditation. It shows how to sense the energy of a home and the animals in it, as a foundation for further animal communication work.

courses.title: Energetic Horsemanship
courses.description: A three-day hands-on workshop at her ranch in Santa Clarita, California, for animal communicators and others who are new to horses. It focuses on presence, energy and communication with horses in the arena.

courses.title: Thula Thula, Where Elephants Remember
courses.description: A nine-day wildlife journey to the Thula Thula reserve in Zululand, South Africa, home of the elephant herd from The Elephant Whisperer. Time with the elephants is combined with animal communication practice in a small group of ten.

free_resources.title: How to Improve Your Confidence While Connecting with Animals
free_resources.description: A free four-part video series, sent by email, covering connection, communication, communion, nature and wildlife, and energy work with animals. It is a starting point for her longer courses.

flags: Animal communication has no subject of its own on the list; consciousness, spirituality, energy-medicine and eft-tapping are used as the nearest fits.

Her sales pages lean heavily on animal health language (pain, illness, lameness, medical intuition); most of her flagship courses were left out under the strict health-claim rule (see left_out), and a human may want to review that line.

Both Shift Network courses were left out: Advanced Animal Communication & Energetic Healing teaches animal medical intuition and claims EFT eases physical pain; Telepathic Communication & Energy Healing With Your Animals ties physical ailments to miscommunication and teaches sensing pain (borderline, dropped).
Emotional Freedom Technique for Animals and Their Humans is co-written with Ellie Laks of The Gentle Barn; it was left out as borderline (its blurb speaks of treating health challenges in animals).
The bio still names Energy Healing for Animals and the EFT book as her published works, factually, although both are left out as items; a human may prefer to drop the titles from the bio.
Photos: Shift headshot and YouTube avatar (with her dog) match; the third, from her site, is a black-and-white photo of her holding a cat.
